# Finnian Murphy — Software Engineer

> Fin Murphy is a Math + Computer Science double major at Georgetown University (Washington, DC) who ships production software across the stack: native iOS apps, AI-integrated full-stack tools, and command-line utilities. His guiding principle is to "build what people AND agents want" — software designed to be used comfortably by humans and consumed cleanly by machines. Available for freelance, contract, and internship engagements.

## Summary

- **Role:** Full-stack & native iOS software engineer; AI-integrated product builder
- **Education:** B.S. Mathematics & Computer Science, Georgetown University
- **Location:** Washington, DC (open to remote)
- **Strengths:** End-to-end product delivery — from low-level systems (C++ data structures and graph algorithms from scratch) to polished, deployed web and mobile apps
- **Working style:** Agile/Scrum, fast iteration on Vercel, AI-assisted development loops (Claude Code)
- **Links:** [GitHub](https://github.com/Fin-Murphy) · [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/finnian-murphy-41a91b332/)

## Skills

- **Frontend:** Next.js, React, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, Tailwind CSS — portfolio sites, product landing pages, deployed web apps
- **Backend & Languages:** Swift & SwiftUI (native iOS), Apple SDK, C++ (low-level systems, B-trees / red-black / binary trees built from scratch, graph algorithms and optimization), Java (web apps), Python (microapps, data analysis)
- **AI Engineering:** OpenAI API, OpenAI TTS / speech synthesis, Cloudflare Workers AI for data processing and organization, AI-assisted development workflows
- **Frameworks & Infra:** Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, Vercel, multithreaded and systems-level design, advanced OOP, Agile/Scrum
- **Tooling:** Xcode, VS Code

## Projects

- [Reverb](https://github.com/Fin-Murphy/Reverb_Public): AI-powered productivity application
- [Protocol Tracker](https://github.com/Fin-Murphy/Protocol-Tracker): native iOS app; production dog-fooding of Reverb
- [Bug Zapper](https://github.com/Fin-Murphy/Bug-Zapper): browser extension for removing annoying page elements
- [ScatterCLI](https://github.com/Fin-Murphy/ScatterCLI): shell interface integrating with Obsidian Kanban boards
- [canvProj](https://github.com/Fin-Murphy/canvProj-main): pipeline turning Canvas assignments into Obsidian.md Kanban cards
- [Portfolio site](https://github.com/Fin-Murphy/portfolio_website): this site — Next.js 16 + React 19 + Tailwind v4 with a custom animated ASCII wave-field background rendered from a pure sine-wave function
- [Customite](https://github.com/Fin-Murphy/Customite-Theme): custom orange theme for Obsidian
- [carrotTheme](https://github.com/Fin-Murphy/carrotTheme): orange theme for VS Code
